//: Tailscale serve config for the FreeSDN 'private access' addon. Exposes the FreeSDN edge on the tailnet at https://<hostname>.<tailnet>.ts.net with a Tailscale-issued cert. ${TS_CERT_DOMAIN} is substituted by the tailscale image. Proxies to the edge's internal HTTP port (use CADDY_SITE_ADDRESS=:80 on the edge so it serves plain HTTP internally and Tailscale terminates TLS).
